The base transfer operating payment is the transfer adjustment factor * $29 775.22 + an uncompensated DSH payment of $71 888.02. The transfer operating threshold is the transfer adjustment factor * $29 847.20 + an uncompensated DSH payment of $71 888.02. If operating cost exceeds the transfer operating threshold  add-ons for qualifying new technology services are included. If operating cost exceeds the transfer operating threshold + the cost of any qualifying new technology services  the stay qualifies for a transfer operating outlier of 80% of the excess amount. The base transfer capital payment is the transfer adjustment factor * $768.31. The transfer capital threshold is the transfer adjustment factor * $768.31. If the capital cost exceeds the transfer capital threshold  the stay qualifies for a transfer capital outlier of 80% of the excess amount. Reimbursement is multiplied by 99% as per the Hospital Acquired Conditions (HAC) program. For stays with condition code 49 or 50  reimbursement is reduced by any reported device reduction amounts.

If operating cost exceeds the transfer operating threshold + the cost of any qualifying new technology services  the stay qualifies for a transfer operating outlier of 80% of the excess amount. The base transfer capital payment is the transfer adjustment factor * $541.50. The transfer capital threshold is the transfer adjustment factor * $541.50. If the capital cost exceeds the transfer capital threshold  the stay qualifies for a transfer capital outlier of 80% of the excess amount.
